description: Hardcore Minecraft mod: death is suspended and you get sixty seconds as a spirit to undo what killed you. Fabric, MC 26.2.

mods.name: Paradox
mods.description: You do not die. You get one shot at stopping it. Paradox records the last 30 seconds, suspends the killing blow, holds your gear in escrow and turns you loose as a vex while the final seconds replay beside you. Fix what killed you and the world winds back, dropping you into your own body to live those seconds again while your ghost's work replays around you.

releases.notes:
**The Remnant now dreads, and colours itself, by the exact thing that made it - not just the family.**

- Cactus (green), sweet berry bush (dark red), a hot floor (gold), freeze (icy blue), a falling stalagmite (blue-grey), a wither rose (ash grey) - each gets its own name colour and dust trail, and puts itself between you and *that* hazard, not the whole family.
- Suffocation (a wall closing in, or too much company in one block) now has a dread reaction where it previously had none.
- An explosion now watches for a lit TNT fuse nearby instead of nothing.
- Fixed a bug where TNT and end-crystal deaths were mislabelled `MOB:tnt` / `MOB:end_crystal` - a dread lookup that can only ever search *living* entities, so it silently never found anything.

**A hidden 15-advancement tree**, granted from the exact moment each thing happens rather than any vanilla trigger: your first rescue, cutting it down to two seconds, meeting and binding a Remnant, reading its letter, spending it down to nothing, having it caged by an Evoker and getting it back, a Warden that will never let go, and a challenge-tier capstone for surviving every kind of death the mod recognises at least once.

*A Small Kindness* (the Allay + amethyst shard interaction) is the one advancement left **visible but locked** - nothing else in the game hints that it exists. Everything else stays hidden on purpose.

**The Remnant no longer farmable.** Only the day's first eligible rescue gets a shot at leaving one behind, win or lose - real close calls are unaffected.

**Fixes:**
- Villagers no longer panic near a bound Remnant, and the truce with an evoker's own Vexes actually holds now. Vanilla's `VillagerHostilesSensor` can't tell an evoker's Vex from yours, and both truces now run every tick instead of every 10 - long enough of a gap before that a villager could finish a full panic cycle or a Vex could re-target and land a hit before the next correction ever caught it.
- The re-live's block placements used to just silently appear. They now land one at a time, in the order you actually placed them, each with its own vanilla place/break sound.
- Most paired chat messages are now a single message instead of two, so a rescue doesn't flood the chat log.

**Art:** the Remnant has a real icon now - `paradox:remnant_sigil` - used on the advancement it's tied to.

### Install

Drop `paradox-1.1.1.jar` into your `mods` folder. Minecraft 26.2, Fabric, with Fabric API 0.149.0+.

releases.notes:
**A Warden now actually eats the Remnant.**

The Warden check sat at the end of the kin-and-predators pass, behind an early return that fired whenever no Evoker was in line of sight. In a Deep Dark — with no evoker for hundreds of blocks — the code that eats the Remnant never ran. The Remnant simply read the Warden as the nearest monster and charged it, and the Warden, having no reason to target a vex, ignored it completely.

- The Warden check runs **first** now, ahead of the Vex truce, the Allay and the Evoker. A Warden in the room outranks everything else the Remnant might be doing.
- It looks around the **Remnant** as well as around you, and takes the nearest one. The Remnant is usually the one out in front, and it is the one the Warden wants.
- The Remnant drops its target and any bind pressure the moment a Warden notices it, so it stops trying to fight the thing that is eating it.
- The Warden roars when it notices, holds its gaze on the Remnant for the whole drain, and drops you as a target while it feeds.

As written: the drain takes about three and a half seconds, and it is permanent. No lives are spent, and nothing brings it back.

### Install

Drop `paradox-1.0.1.jar` into your `mods` folder. Minecraft 26.2, Fabric, with Fabric API 0.149.0+.
